experiment_data.hypothesis: Heterogeneous-Temperature Sampling: MRSC/LSC negative results prove entity-level correction cannot close the selection gap. F4 degeneracy analysis shows T=0.7 has ~62% degeneracy (too homogeneous) while T=1.0 has more diversity but noisier entities. Mixing samples from different temperatures (k from T_low + (8-k) from T_high) breaks temperature-specific degeneracy patterns: low-T samples provide precise entities, high-T samples provide diversity. Mixed-T N=8 pool should achieve lower degeneracy than pure T_low and higher construction F1 than pure T_high. Hypothesis source: entity-level methods (MRSC weighted re-prompting, LSC latent aggregation) both failed → pivot to sampling-level diversity improvement.

spec.eval_data: SciERC test set, 551 instances, T={0.5,0.8,1.0} samples from exp_026
